2-BOSQICH

Dastlab Product modelini tuzamiz

Model — database jadvalining Python ko‘rinishi. Frontdagi mahsulot kartasida nima chiqsa, modelda o‘sha fieldlar bo‘ladi.

Product jadvali
nameMahsulot nomiChar
slugURL uchun nomSlug
priceNarxDecimal
categoryKategoriyaChar
imageRasm URLURL
is_activeSaytda ko‘rinadimi?Bool
Vizual mantiq: har bitta Product obyekti frontdagi bitta product cardga aylanadi.
products/models.py
Product modeli
from django.db import models

class Product(models.Model):
    name = models.CharField(max_length=150)
    slug = models.SlugField(unique=True)
    description = models.TextField(blank=True)
    price = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2)
    old_price = models.DecimalField(
        max_digits=10,
        decimal_places=2,
        null=True,
        blank=True
    )
    category = models.CharField(max_length=80)
    image = models.URLField(blank=True)
    stock = models.PositiveIntegerField(default=0)
    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

    def __str__(self):
        return self.name
SERIALIZER

Serializer: modelni JSONga aylantiradi

Frontend Python obyektni tushunmaydi. Serializer model ichidagi kerakli fieldlarni tanlab, tartibli JSON response qilib beradi.

Product object
Python / Django
JSON
Frontend uchun
{ "id": 1, "name": "iPhone 15", "price": "899.00" }
Field tanlash

Frontendga faqat kerakli ustunlar yuboriladi: nom, narx, rasm, kategoriya, stock.

Xavfsiz response

Admin uchun kerak bo‘lgan ichki ma’lumotlar JSONga chiqib ketmaydi.

Front bilan moslik

Product card va detail sahifa aynan shu JSON tuzilmasiga qarab chiziladi.

products/serializers.py
ProductSerializer
from rest_framework import serializers
from .models import Product

class ProductSerializer(serializers.ModelSerializer):
    class Meta:
        model = Product
        fields = [
            'id',
            'name',
            'slug',
            'description',
            'price',
            'old_price',
            'category',
            'image',
            'stock',
            'is_active',
            'created_at',
        ]
VIEWS

List va Detail view yozamiz

ListAPIView barcha mahsulotlarni, RetrieveAPIView esa bitta mahsulotni qaytaradi.

products/views.py
List + Detail
from rest_framework.generics import ListAPIView, RetrieveAPIView
from .models import Product
from .serializers import ProductSerializer

class ProductListView(ListAPIView):
    serializer_class = ProductSerializer

    def get_queryset(self):
        return Product.objects.filter(is_active=True)

class ProductDetailView(RetrieveAPIView):
    serializer_class = ProductSerializer
    lookup_field = 'pk'

    def get_queryset(self):
        return Product.objects.filter(is_active=True)

/api/products/

Nega ikkita view?

List ko‘p obyekt qaytaradi, detail esa bitta ID bo‘yicha aniq obyekt qaytaradi.

URLS

Endpoint yo‘llarini ulaymiz

View yozilgani bilan endpoint ochilmaydi. Uni urls.pyga ulash kerak.

products/urls.py
Products endpointlar
from django.urls import path
from .views import ProductListView, ProductDetailView

urlpatterns = [
    path('products/', ProductListView.as_view(), name='product-list'),
    path('products/<int:pk>/', ProductDetailView.as_view(), name='product-detail'),
]
config/urls.py
App URLni projectga ulash
from django.contrib import admin
from django.urls import path, include

urlpatterns = [
    path('admin/', admin.site.urls),
    path('api/', include('products.urls')),
]

4-BOSQICH

Bitta mahsulot uchun detail endpoint

User cardni bosganda frontend ID orqali bitta mahsulot ma'lumotini olib, detail sahifani ko‘rsatadi.

frontend.uz/products/1
1Mahsulot rasmi
Detail endpointdan kelgan image URL frontenddagi katta previewga qo‘yiladi.
2Nomi + tavsif + narx
GET /api/products/1/ shu blok uchun kerak bo‘lgan barcha maydonlarni qaytaradi.
3Action qismi
Quantity, savatga qo‘shish va buyurtma tugmalari detail sahifadagi ma’lumotga tayangan holda ishlaydi.
4-bosqich vazifasi: user listdagi “Batafsil” tugmasini bossachi, frontend mahsulot ID sini olib detail endpointga so‘rov yuboradi va shu sahifa to‘ladi.

Lumina: mahsulotlar bo‘limi uchun endpoint

Topshiriq shartlari
  • • Product model: name, description, price, old_price, category, image, rating
  • • Serializer orqali card uchun kerakli fieldlarni chiqaring
  • • List endpoint faqat active mahsulotlarni qaytarsin
  • • Detail endpoint ID yoki slug orqali ishlasin

SEARCHING

Searching: nomi yoki description bo‘yicha qidirish

Frontend inputga yozilgan matn query parameter orqali backendga ketadi: ?search=iphone.

Search qismi — list sahifadagi input
iphone
GET
/api/products/?search=iphone

Backend name va description ichidan moslarini topadi.

products/views.py
SearchFilter qo‘shish
from rest_framework.generics import ListAPIView, RetrieveAPIView
from rest_framework.filters import SearchFilter
from .models import Product
from .serializers import ProductSerializer

class ProductListView(ListAPIView):
    serializer_class = ProductSerializer
    queryset = Product.objects.filter(is_active=True)
    filter_backends = [SearchFilter]
    search_fields = ['name', 'description', 'category']
FILTERING

Filtering: kategoriya va narx bo‘yicha tanlash

Filter frontenddagi select, checkbox yoki range inputlardan keladi.

Filter qismi — chap sidebar
category
phones
price
0 - 1000
GET
/api/products/?category=phones&min_price=100&max_price=1000
products/filters.py + views.py
DjangoFilterBackend
# pip install django-filter

import django_filters
from .models import Product

class ProductFilter(django_filters.FilterSet):
    min_price = django_filters.NumberFilter(field_name='price', lookup_expr='gte')
    max_price = django_filters.NumberFilter(field_name='price', lookup_expr='lte')

    class Meta:
        model = Product
        fields = ['category', 'is_active']

# views.py
from django_filters.rest_framework import DjangoFilterBackend
from .filters import ProductFilter

class ProductListView(ListAPIView):
    serializer_class = ProductSerializer
    queryset = Product.objects.filter(is_active=True)
    filter_backends = [DjangoFilterBackend]
    filterset_class = ProductFilter
PAGINATION

Pagination: mahsulotlarni sahifalash

Agar 1000 ta mahsulot bo‘lsa, hammasini birdan yubormaymiz. Page bo‘yicha bo‘lib yuboramiz.

1
2
3
...
GET
/api/products/?page=2

Frontend “Next” bosilganda keyingi page so‘raydi.

Natija: response ichida count, next, previous, results keladi.
Eslatma: list sahifadagi card grid ko‘payib ketganda, pastki qismga pagination tugmalari chiqadi va frontend ?page=2 kabi query yuboradi.
products/views.py
Class ichida pagination
from rest_framework.generics import ListAPIView
from rest_framework.pagination import PageNumberPagination

from .models import Product
from .serializers import ProductSerializer


class ProductPagination(PageNumberPagination):
    page_size = 6
    page_size_query_param = 'page_size'
    max_page_size = 100


class ProductListAPIView(ListAPIView):
    queryset = Product.objects.all()
    serializer_class = ProductSerializer
    pagination_class = ProductPagination
SORTING

Sorting: narx yoki sana bo‘yicha tartiblash

Frontenddagi “Cheap first”, “Expensive first”, “Newest” selectlari backendga ordering query yuboradi.

Sorting — yuqoridagi select
price
arzon → qimmat
-price
qimmat → arzon
-created_at
yangi avval
GET
/api/products/?ordering=-price
products/views.py
OrderingFilter
from rest_framework.filters import OrderingFilter

class ProductListView(ListAPIView):
    serializer_class = ProductSerializer
    queryset = Product.objects.filter(is_active=True)
    filter_backends = [OrderingFilter]
    ordering_fields = ['price', 'created_at', 'name']
    ordering = ['-created_at']

MUSTAQIL ISH

Lumina uchun search, filter, ordering va pagination

Kod yozishdan oldin endpoint qanday ishlashini aniq tasavvur qiling: bitta products endpoint turli query parameterlar bilan har xil natija qaytaradi.

lumina.uz/products
Searching

Search inputdan kelgan so‘rov: ?search=sneakers

Filtering

Category select: ?category=poyabzal

Ordering

Ommabop yoki narx bo‘yicha: ?ordering=-rating

Pagination

Har sahifada 6 ta mahsulot: ?page=2

Yakuniy endpoint
/api/products/?search=tee&category=kiyim&ordering=-rating&page=1

Natijada Lumina katalog sahifasi qidiradi, filterlaydi, tartiblaydi va sahifalab beradi.
